sources.lucerne_probability_table: Senn et al. 2023, A predictive coding approach to modelling the perceived complexity of popular music drum patterns, Table 3

direct_reclassification_test.description: Existing generated kick/snare notes were relabeled only by metric-position prior while preserving near-simultaneous kick+snare pairs. This is a diagnostic, not the adopted algorithm.

downbeat_four_candidate_test.description: Using the current real-browser generated MIDI events, choose among four beat-phase offsets with the corpus prior alone.
downbeat_four_candidate_test.decision: use prior only to break near-ties in low_fallback

reference_window_test.description: Exact downbeat offset selected from chart.mid using only the corpus prior; 4/4 bars only.
reference_window_test.interpretation: Useful supporting evidence, but not sufficient alone because common grooves are often symmetric between beats 1 and 3.
